To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the coherence among the business model and the leadership model (in particular, the values-virtues-based leadership model) is a key driver of the company’s sustainability.

the coherence among the company mission, the governance model and the accountability model is a driver for an effective business model, and that sustainable business model derives from and is characterized by sustainable leadership model which includes transformational, ethical based and values-virtue driven leadership.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis and discussion of a case-study of sustainable business model and sustainable leadership in the oil & gas sector.
the analysis of the evolution of a business model toward a sustainable business model, with a specific attention to the coherence among mission-governance-accountability and the leadership models.

how to improve the coherence among mission-governance-accountability and how to improve the sustainability orientation of the business model through the adoption of sustainable leadership models, in order to increase the resilience of the business model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the coherence between mission, governance and leadership is a necessary and sufficient condition to achieve sustainability in business model, and vice versa.

sustainable business models are based on the coherence between the mission, the accountability and the governance, which are supported by a virtuous leadership model, based on values, ethics and transformation.

a sustainable business model is based on an ethical leadership model, which is based on the mission-governor-accountability coherence and is driven by a values-virtues-based transformational leadership.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the coherence among the three elements of the mission, governance and accounting is the key driver for effective and sustainable business models and that sustainable business model is the outcome of sustainable leadership model which is transformational, ethical and based on the virtues of values.
a sustainable business model is a key driver of the sustainability of the company and that a transformational leadership model is a key element in the development of a sustainable business model.

the coherence of a sustainable business model is based on the coherence between mission, governance and stakeholders’ engagement, and that the leadership model which supports the business model is ethical-based and values-driven.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a sustainable business model can be achieved by means of an ethical-based transformation leadership model which, at the same time, is supported by a mission-governance-accountability coherence.
a sustainable business model is based on the coherence among the three pillars (mission, governance and accountability) of the business model.

the sustainable business model can be a key driver of resilience, especially during a pandemic crisis, and that the sustainable leadership model can support the renewal and improvement of the business model towards sustainability.
